How do I put a video inside a Christmas card?
Upload the video somewhere with a shareable link — an unlisted YouTube video is perfect — make a QR code from the link, and print it inside the card. One scan and it plays.
Can a code add the party to my guests’ calendars?
Yes. The Event type (the studio below starts on it) carries the title, time and place; one scan adds the party to their calendar app.
Will the code still work next Christmas?
Yes — static codes never expire. The same printed code works next year too, as long as the page or video behind it is still online.
I need a different code on every gift tag. Help?
Use Batch mode in the generator: one link per line, one code per tag, all downloaded as a ZIP.
